title: Liquid Deposition on Custom Surface
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect an Opentrons OT‑2 robot, a P20 single‑channel pipette (or compatible multi‑channel pipette), a 20 µL tiprack, a USA Scientific 96‑deep‑well plate (2.4 mL), and any reservoirs needed for liquids.

steps.title: Calibrate deck and tip
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 calibration routine, calibrate to the top‑left‑most spot of the top‑left‑most grid on the shaker (point A) and set the pipette tip position just above the centre of this spot.

steps.title: Create offsets CSV
steps.instruction: Prepare a CSV file (e.g., offsets.csv) with a header line `x offset (in mm),y offset (in mm)` followed by rows of x‑ and y‑offsets (in mm) for each additional grid. Example rows: `50,0`, `0,70`, `50,70`. These offsets define the location of each extra grid relative to the calibrated point.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App protocol editor, input the desired parameters (volumes, number of spots, etc.) as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, unzip the contents if necessary, and locate the Python (.py) file and any custom labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload each custom labware JSON file.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App Protocol tab, upload the protocol Python file (.py).

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the deck map: place the custom plate occupying slots 1‑9, load the 20 µL tiprack, and position any reservoirs.

steps.title: Load liquids into reservoirs
steps.instruction: If using a multi‑channel pipette, fill reservoir wells A1‑D1 with liquids A‑D and wells E2‑H2 with liquids E‑H. If using a single‑channel pipette, fill wells A1‑H1 with liquids A‑H.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT‑App calibration for the labware, tiprack, and pipette, following the on‑screen instructions (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT‑App to start the liquid spotting transfers.
